recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. No core follow-up is needed unless the work group separately wants to review the external/API-incubator GraphDefinition material.
issue_request: FHIR-19651 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request, voted 7-0-0 on 2019-04-29 and applied for R5, asking the Boundaries and Relationships sections for GraphDefinition and CompartmentDefinition to explain their overlap and distinguish CompartmentDefinition's search-parameter-based compartments from GraphDefinition's more expressive grouping model.
initial_application: Commit ab4179d05ced32f5ad816ef3c2f4bc51562038e1 explicitly applied FHIR-19651 by adding the requested reciprocal text to source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml and source/graphdefinition/graphdefinition-introduction.xml. Later commit 93e0bc90e3a80969bae01ab57e37a0cb9221ee68 for FHIR-25474 retained the GraphDefinition/CompartmentDefinition distinction while adjusting nearby GraphDefinition wording and grammar.
additional_context: The current source/fhir.ini actively lists CompartmentDefinition, and source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml lines 76-77 still contain the requested comparison. GraphDefinition is not active in current core: source/fhir.ini no longer lists GraphDefinition and source/graphdefinition is absent after commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the resource during R6 normative changes. Current core references to GraphDefinition point to the API incubator resource rather than a core GraphDefinition page. Community searching found no conflicting Zulip discussion, and Confluence minutes corroborate the FHIR-I approval.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk is needed because the active CompartmentDefinition text is already correct and there is no current core GraphDefinition source page to update.

related_jiras.note: Later GraphDefinition wording update retained the FHIR-19651 CompartmentDefinition distinction before GraphDefinition was removed from the core build.
